Marty's Tuesday Evening Road Ride

Morristown, NJ · Loantaka Park · Road

Marty's Tuesday Evening Road Ride is a road group ride in Morristown, NJ. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Loantaka Park. About 20–40 miles, 17–18 mph in spring, 18–20 mph in summer.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @martysreliable the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Marty's Tuesday Evening Road Ride group ride

The shop's faster weeknight ride, for experienced riders. It is a drop ride and the route changes weekly. Marty's also runs Saturday rides from its Morristown and Randolph stores and Sunday rides from East Hanover and Morristown.
